prompt: Complete ExtensionFileFilter.namesWithExtension so it returns the sorted names of the regular files directly inside a directory whose extension matches, ignoring case.
explanation: Files.list gives one level of a directory, unlike Files.walk which descends into sub-directories, so it is the right tool when the task says "do not recurse". Checking Files.isRegularFile matters because a directory can perfectly well be named archive.txt. Lower-casing both the name and the "." + extension suffix with an explicit Locale makes the comparison case-insensitive without surprises in locales where toLowerCase behaves unusually.
hints: Files.list(dir) returns a Stream<Path> that must be closed -- use try-with-resources.
entry.getFileName().toString() gives just the name; build the suffix as "." + extension before comparing.
Lower-case both sides before endsWith, and sort the collected names with Collections.sort before returning.
